levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The plan assumes a transport mode not realistically available and does not name any backup.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The plan uses realistic modes and includes at least one backup for at least one leg.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The plan accounts for a specific likely disruption (weather, timing, availability) with a workable response.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The revision does not reflect anything the review or self-check actually flagged.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The revision directly addresses something the review or self-check identified.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The learner names the most fragile leg of the plan honestly, even after revision.

lookFors: The plan never assumes a personal vehicle as the only option.
At least one backup option is present for at least one leg of the trip.
No real ride-share account, payment method, or address is required or present.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
